scope: WornPathA-to-DanchiPlaza physical termination, metric soil replacement, curb continuation suppression, fail-closed QA, native-4K evidence binding

qa: enforce worn-path plaza curb termination
qa: bind path termination to native 4K packet

geometry: replace overlapping worn-path box with authored mouth

sourceAudit.finding: A curb-only correction was insufficient because the coarse WornPathA Cube itself would still leave an approximately 0.70 m visible strip east of the plaza while overlapping the higher paving elsewhere. The final design therefore preserves the source collider but disables its renderer and supplies a separate authored visible soil surface that ends at the plaza boundary.

implementation.weathering: cause-based foot traffic, UV exposure and ground splash metadata; no painted shadow/highlight

qaEnforcement: source WornPathA renderer must be disabled while its gameplay collider remains enabled
visible replacement must use an authored GM_HD_ mesh and contain no collider
visible path max Z may not continue beyond the plaza south edge
mouth top must finish approximately 1 mm below paving to avoid coplanar z-fighting
UV0 span must correspond to world-metre geometry and macro/detail texture transforms must match physical tile sizes
retained curb modules must use authored meshes, dielectric PBR_WashedConcrete, physical normal/roughness maps and weathering metadata
legacy curb modules 07-13 on both sides must remain renderer-disabled
first suppressed module must still match the documented source continuation datum so coordinate drift fails closed
all checks are repeated before reflection capture, immediately before Camera.Render and before temporal capture
selfAudit: Initial curb-only proposal was rejected inside the same run after source-bounds analysis proved the approximately 0.70 m east WornPathA strip would survive beside the plaza.

Final implementation splits gameplay collision from render geometry: the coarse source Cube remains collision-only and the visible path becomes an authored surface with physical-scale UVs and a deliberate plaza mouth.
A semantic JSON-key rename was reverted because the C# parser still referenced the original serialized field name; schema/parser agreement was prioritized over cosmetic naming.

visualFidelity.reason: No real Unity render, 100% crop or temporal evidence exists for this head. Source-side geometry/material/QA changes cannot earn visual points.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryAndConstruction: Potentially removes a primitive-overlap/path-termination deduction and a curb-continuation construction contradiction if actual pixels confirm the replacement.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.materialPbr: Potentially improves physical soil/concrete separation by forcing dielectric PBR and physical normal/roughness bindings; unverified in pixels.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.textureMicrodetailTexel: Potentially reduces normalized-UV stretch/repetition via metre UV plus 6.4 m macro and 0.30 m detail scales; temporal stability unverified.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.weatheringContextCausality: Adds foot-traffic/UV/ground-splash metadata tied to the real path exposure instead of random decorative staining.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.periodAccuracyAuthenticity: Potentially makes the plaza connection read as ordinary residential path infrastructure rather than a generated overlap; exact historic-product dimensions are not claimed.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLodAliasing: No geometry-changing LOD is introduced for this small correction until temporal evidence justifies one.
